title: IoT-Based Smart Medicine Box for Medication Adherence
description: QR-code-enabled smart medicine box using real-time embedded sensing to reduce prescription errors and improve medication adherence. Paper accepted at QPAIN 2026.

title: Explainable & Privacy-Preserving IIoT Cyber Threat Monitoring
description: CNN-LSTM based anomaly detection with SHAP explainability for resource-constrained Industrial IoT devices, mapped against MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0.

title: New Research Collaborations
description: Open to joining or co-leading new research work in embedded IoT systems, applied machine learning, or industrial cybersecurity — as a co-researcher, research intern, or industry partner.
